evaluate(deg, xi)[source]

Evaluate polynomial system up to degree deg at points xi.

Parameters:

  • deg (int) – Highest polynomial degree to evaluate.

  • xi (array_like) – Points at which the polynomials are evaluated.

Returns:

y_alpha_j – Matrix of shape (len(xi), deg+1) containing evaluated polynomials.

Return type:

numpy.ndarray

Return the squared norm of the polynomials of degree n.

Parameters:

n (array_like) – Degrees for which the squared norms are computed.

Returns:

nrm2 – Array of squared norms corresponding to degrees in n.

Return type:

numpy.ndarray

sqnorm_by_rc(rc)[source]

Return the squared norm using recurrence coefficients rc.

Parameters:

rc (array_like) – Recurrence coefficients of shape (deg, 3).

nrm2 – Array of squared norms for polynomials up to degree deg.

numpy.ndarray
